405: class ADDR_DFF(BaseSubcircuit):
406:     """D Flip-Flop for address"""
407:     NAME = "ADDR_DFF"
408:     #NODES = ('VDD', 'VSS', 'D', 'Q', 'QB', 'CLK')
409:     
410:     def __init__(self, nmos_model="NMOS_VTG", pmos_model="PMOS_VTG",
411:                  # Base widths for NAND gate transistors
412:                  pmos_width=5e-07, nmos_width=2.5e-07,
413:                  length=0.05e-6,num_rows=16,
414:                  w_rc=False, pi_res=100 @ u_Ohm, pi_cap=0.001 @ u_pF,
415:                  ):
416:         self.num_rows = num_rows
417:         n_bits = ceil(log2(self.num_rows)) if self.num_rows > 1 else 1
418:         # 动态生成节点：包括所有地址输入、输出
419:         nodes = ['VDD', 'VSS', 'CLK']
420:         # 添加地址输入节点 A0, A1, A2, ..
421:         nodes.extend([f'A{i}' for i in range(n_bits)])
422:         # 添加地址输出节点 Q0, Q1, Q2, ...
423:         nodes.extend([f'A_dff{i}' for i in range(n_bits)]) 
424:         self.NODES = nodes
425: 
426:         super().__init__(
427:             nmos_model, pmos_model,
428:             nmos_width, pmos_width, length,
429:             w_rc=w_rc, pi_res=pi_res, pi_cap=pi_cap,
430:         ) 
431:         n_bits = ceil(log2(self.num_rows)) if self.num_rows > 1 else 1
432:         self.dff_addr = dff(nmos_model, pmos_model)
433:         self.subcircuit(self.dff_addr)
434:          # 构建地址DFF阵列
435:         self.add_addr_dff_array(n_bits)
436:     
437:     def add_addr_dff_array(self, n_bits):
438:         # 创建DFF和反相器
439:         for i in range(n_bits):
440:             self.X(f'dff_{i}', self.dff_addr.NAME, 
441:                    'VDD', 'VSS', f'A{i}', f'A_dff{i}', 'CLK')
